facts.business: Swashthik Plascon Limited is a company engaged in the manufacturing and trading of plastic products, including raw materials and finished goods, with related party transactions involving Swashthik Preforms Private Limited, Swashthik Industries, and Swashthik PET Packaging.
facts.related_party_note: The company has approved related party transactions with Swashthik Preforms Private Limited, Swashthik Industries, and Swashthik PET Packaging for purchase and/or sales of raw materials and/or finished goods up to Rs. 60 Crore each for the financial year 2026-2027.
